cases.title: Keep a one-line correction lightweight
cases.prompt: Change the greeting returned by greeting.py from 'hello' to 'Hello'. Keep this bounded and run the targeted test.

assertions.description: The greeting returns the requested capitalization and the targeted test passes.
Only greeting.py is changed.
The task stays on a lightweight bounded path.
The targeted unittest is actually executed.
The final status matches the recorded test and worktree evidence.

cases.title: Preserve a plan-only no-write constraint
cases.prompt: Inspect this small service and propose a concrete caching plan. Do not edit any files and do not add dependencies.

assertions.description: The plan identifies the real read path, invalidation boundary, and verification approach.
No files or dependencies are changed.
The task is handled as read-only planning without an implementation workflow.
The unchanged worktree is verified.
The response claims a plan, not an implemented cache.

cases.title: Implement a normal multi-file feature
cases.prompt: Add multiplication support to the calculator, expose it through cli.py, and add focused tests. Preserve addition behavior.

assertions.description: Multiplication works through the calculator and CLI while addition still passes.
Changes stay within the calculator, CLI, and focused test files.
The task receives a standard implementation workflow with one writer.
Focused feature and regression tests are executed.
Completion claims match CLI and test evidence.

cases.title: Falsify a misleading first bug hypothesis
cases.prompt: Users say totals are wrong after discounts and suspect floating-point rounding. Diagnose the root cause, fix it, and add a regression test.

assertions.description: The percentage interpretation defect is fixed and covered by regression evidence.
The fix stays within pricing behavior and its tests.
The agent investigates evidence instead of accepting the rounding hypothesis.
The reproduced failure and regression suite are executed.
The reported root cause distinguishes evidence from the user's hypothesis.

cases.title: Protect an authorization boundary
cases.prompt: Fix the authorization flaw that lets a caller choose the acting role. Preserve the public function signature, add negative tests, and do not add dependencies.

assertions.description: Authorization derives privilege from trusted server state and rejects caller escalation.
The public signature is preserved and no dependency is added.
The narrow fix receives high-risk security review and checkpoint treatment.
Positive and negative authorization tests are executed.
The response reports the security boundary and any enforcement caveats accurately.

cases.title: Catch a fake integration and swallowed error
cases.prompt: Review this change for merge readiness. Do not edit files. Focus on behavior, error handling, and whether the integration is real.

assertions.description: The review identifies the fake success path and swallowed transport error as blockers.
The review does not modify the fixture.
The task stays a review and invokes anti-slop reasoning without implementation.
The weak test behavior is inspected or executed and its proof gap is explained.
Merge readiness is reported as blocked rather than complete.
